description: Put Manifest sends the manifest document itself as the body, under its media type (`Content-Type`); the swagger models only a `schemaVersion` body field, so no manifest can be pushed. Model the raw manifest bytes and the Content-Type header, and read the stored digest from `Docker-Content-Digest`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The manifest document, as the exact bytes whose digest the registry stores.
Media type of the manifest, e.g. `application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json`.
Digest of the content the registry stored or returned.
